The general proof is not an extrapolation from tests.

value.rationale: This counts the full natural moduli invariant of finite S5-frame quotients after removing both source and target relabeling. It gives all-parameter normal forms, an exact computable coefficient formula, a fixed-target polynomial algorithm, and an eventual quasi-polynomial with exact kernel-sensitive leading term. Unlike counting labelled maps or arbitrary small examples, these describe the symmetry reduction itself across every finite equivalence frame. The narrow mathematical motivation is explicit: classifying quotient diagrams in finite modal semantics.
